# Sequence diagrams

One per endpoint, traced through the TypeScript source: the guards and pipes Nest runs first, then every call from the controller down to the database. Each branch in a guard, pipe or handler that ends in an HTTP error is drawn (arrows ending in x), not only the success path. Errors from before the guards, such as 415 for a body that isn't JSON, are left out.

## POST /auth/login

Handled by `AuthController.login` in `backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant ThrottlerGuard
  participant ValidationPipe
  participant AuthController
  participant AuthService
  participant UsersService
  participant JwtService
  participant DB as Database
  Client->>ThrottlerGuard: POST /auth/login
  opt Too many login attempts
    ThrottlerGuard--xClient: 429 Too Many Requests
  end
  ThrottlerGuard->>ValidationPipe: body LoginDto
  opt Invalid email or missing password
    ValidationPipe--xClient: 400 Bad Request
  end
  ValidationPipe->>+AuthController: login(dto, response)
  AuthController->>+AuthService: login(dto)
  AuthService->>+UsersService: findByEmailWithPassword(email)
  UsersService->>+DB: getOne() on users
  DB-->>-UsersService: User #124; null
  UsersService-->>-AuthService: User #124; null
  AuthService->>AuthService: bcryptjs.compare(password, ...)
  opt !user #124;#124; !passwordMatches
    AuthService--xClient: 401 Invalid email or password
  end
  AuthService->>+JwtService: signAsync(payload)
  JwtService-->>-AuthService: string
  AuthService-->>-AuthController: LoginResponseDto
  AuthController->>AuthController: response.cookie(AUTH_COOKIE_NAME, result.accessToken, ...)
  AuthController-->>-Client: 200 LoginResponseDto
```

## GET /auth/me

Handled by `AuthController.me` in `backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant JwtAuthGuard as JwtAuthGuard (JwtStrategy)
  participant UsersService
  participant AuthController
  participant DB as Database
  Client->>JwtAuthGuard: GET /auth/me
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: passport-jwt authenticates the request
  opt authenticated
    JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: JwtStrategy.validate(payload)
    JwtAuthGuard->>+UsersService: findById(payload.sub)
    UsersService->>+DB: findOneBy() on users
    DB-->>-UsersService: User #124; null
    UsersService-->>-JwtAuthGuard: User #124; null
    opt !user
      JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Authentication required
    end
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: handleRequest(error, user, info)
  opt error #124;#124; !user
    JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Access token has expired / Authentication required
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>+AuthController: me(user)
  AuthController-->>-Client: 200 UserProfileDto
```

## GET /invoices

Handled by `InvoicesController.list` in `backend/src/invoices/invoices.controller.ts`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant JwtAuthGuard as JwtAuthGuard (JwtStrategy)
  participant UsersService
  participant ValidationPipe
  participant InvoicesController
  participant InvoicesService
  participant Clock
  participant InvoicesRepository
  participant DB as Database
  Client->>JwtAuthGuard: GET /invoices
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: passport-jwt authenticates the request
  opt authenticated
    JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: JwtStrategy.validate(payload)
    JwtAuthGuard->>+UsersService: findById(payload.sub)
    UsersService->>+DB: findOneBy() on users
    DB-->>-UsersService: User #124; null
    UsersService-->>-JwtAuthGuard: User #124; null
    opt !user
      JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Authentication required
    end
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: handleRequest(error, user, info)
  opt error #124;#124; !user
    JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Access token has expired / Authentication required
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>ValidationPipe: query ListInvoicesQueryDto
  opt Invalid query parameters
    ValidationPipe--xClient: 400 Bad Request
  end
  ValidationPipe->>+InvoicesController: list(query)
  InvoicesController->>+InvoicesService: list(query)
  InvoicesService->>+Clock: today()
  Clock-->>-InvoicesService: string
  InvoicesService->>+InvoicesRepository: list(query, today)
  InvoicesRepository->>+DB: getManyAndCount() on invoices
  DB-->>-InvoicesRepository: [Invoice[], number]
  InvoicesRepository-->>-InvoicesService: [Invoice[], number]
  InvoicesService-->>-InvoicesController: InvoiceListResponseDto
  InvoicesController-->>-Client: 200 InvoiceListResponseDto
```

## POST /invoices

Handled by `InvoicesController.create` in `backend/src/invoices/invoices.controller.ts`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant JwtAuthGuard as JwtAuthGuard (JwtStrategy)
  participant UsersService
  participant ValidationPipe
  participant InvoicesController
  participant InvoicesService
  participant InvoicesRepository
  participant Clock
  participant DB as Database
  Client->>JwtAuthGuard: POST /invoices
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: passport-jwt authenticates the request
  opt authenticated
    JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: JwtStrategy.validate(payload)
    JwtAuthGuard->>+UsersService: findById(payload.sub)
    UsersService->>+DB: findOneBy() on users
    DB-->>-UsersService: User #124; null
    UsersService-->>-JwtAuthGuard: User #124; null
    opt !user
      JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Authentication required
    end
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>JwtAuthGuard: handleRequest(error, user, info)
  opt error #124;#124; !user
    JwtAuthGuard--xClient: 401 Access token has expired / Authentication required
  end
  JwtAuthGuard->>ValidationPipe: body CreateInvoiceDto
  opt Validation failed
    ValidationPipe--xClient: 400 Bad Request
  end
  ValidationPipe->>+InvoicesController: create(dto, user)
  InvoicesController->>+InvoicesService: create(dto, user.id)
  InvoicesService->>InvoicesService: totalsFor(item.quantity, item.rate, taxPercent, dto.discount)
  opt on error, if error instanceof DiscountExceedsTotalError
    InvoicesService--xClient: 400 Bad Request
  end
  InvoicesService->>+InvoicesRepository: build(...)
  InvoicesRepository-->>-InvoicesService: Invoice
  InvoicesService->>+InvoicesRepository: insert(invoice)
  InvoicesRepository->>+DB: save() on invoices
  DB-->>-InvoicesRepository: Invoice
  InvoicesRepository-->>-InvoicesService: string
  opt on error, if isUniqueViolation(error, INVOICE_NUMBER_UNIQUE_INDEX)
    InvoicesService--xClient: 409 Invoice number already exists
  end
  InvoicesService->>InvoicesService: findOne(id)
  InvoicesService->>+InvoicesRepository: findById(id)
  InvoicesRepository->>+DB: findOne() on invoices
  DB-->>-InvoicesRepository: Invoice #124; null
  InvoicesRepository-->>-InvoicesService: Invoice #124; null
  opt !invoice
    InvoicesService--xClient: 404 Invoice not found
  end
  InvoicesService->>+Clock: today()
  Clock-->>-InvoicesService: string
  InvoicesService-->>-InvoicesController: InvoiceResponseDto
  InvoicesController-->>-Client: 201 InvoiceResponseDto
```

## GET /health

Handled by `HealthController.check` in `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant HealthController
  participant DB as Database
  Client->>+HealthController: GET /health<br/>check()
  HealthController->>+DB: SELECT 1
  DB-->>-HealthController: rows
  opt on error
    HealthController--xClient: 503 Database unavailable
  end
  HealthController-->>-Client: 200 #123; status #125;
```
